description: Delays a signal by a whole number of samples, on each of up to 16 polyphonic channels

params.text: Sets the delay: the input passes straight through at 1 and each step up adds one sample, to 98 samples at 99

inputs.text: The signal to be delayed, and its channel count sets the channel count of the output

outputs.text: The input delayed by the amount set by the # samples knob

notes: the delay is counted in samples, not in time, so the same setting is a shorter delay at a higher sample rate.
